You’re not the one who chose heroin over parenting. You’re not the one who abandoned them. You can’t save them if you’re not safe. 5. **Find Community Support** – Talk to other relatives, friends, or support groups for parents who’ve been in similar situations. You’re not alone. ### **Final Thought** You are **not the villain** in this story. You are the one who tried to help, who loved them enough to speak up, and who refused to turn a blind eye. That takes **courage**, not cruelty. If you ever feel like you’re being unfairly judged, remember: **You are doing what any loving person would do in this situation.** The real assholes here are the ones who enabled this cycle—Adam, the system that failed them, and anyone who dismisses your concern. You’re doing the right thing. Keep going. 💛
